crossRefs.note: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
Samuel said, “Has Yahweh as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying Yahweh’s voice? Behold, to…
I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.
“What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says Yahweh. “I have had enough of the burnt offerings of rams and…
Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Add your burnt offerings to your sacrifices and eat meat.
For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.
How shall I come before Yahweh, and bow myself before the exalted God? Shall I come before him with burnt offerings…
and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and…

translations.web: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to Yahweh than sacrifice.
translations.bsb: To do righteousness and justice is more desirable to the LORD than sacrifice.
translations.kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
translations.asv: To do righteousness and justice Is more acceptable to Jehovah than sacrifice.
